papers.title: Post-processing effects on the surface characteristics of Inconel 718 alloy fabricated by selective laser melting additive manufacturing

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Inconel 718合金的SLM后处理表面特性，未涉及生物医用植入物或应力遮挡、疲劳等关键问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on Inconel 718, a non-biomedical alloy, and does not address stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue, or osseointegration relevant to AM biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究后处理对SLM成型Inconel 718表面特性的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用热处理和抛光等后处理工艺，表征表面粗糙度与微观结构
summary_zh.result: 后处理显著改善表面质量，但对力学性能影响有限
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、粗糙度测试和拉伸试验验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effects of post-processing treatments on the surface characteristics of Inconel 718 fabricated by selective laser melting
summary_en.method: Various post-processing techniques including heat treatment and surface polishing were applied, followed by characterization of surface roughness, microstructure, and mechanical properties
summary_en.result: Post-processing significantly improved surface quality but had limited impact on mechanical properties
summary_en.validation: Surface scanning electron microscopy, roughness measurements, and tensile testing were used

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是选择性激光熔化制备亚稳态不锈钢的力学性能，未涉及生物医学植入物、多孔结构或应力屏蔽。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants; it focuses on material ductility and TRIP effect in a non-biomedical stainless steel.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究低功率SLM加工亚稳态不锈钢的高塑性和TRIP效应。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验分析SLM工艺参数对显微组织和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.result: 发现低功率SLM可获得高塑性，归因于TRIP效应。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和显微组织表征验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the high ductility and transformation-induced plasticity (TRIP) in metastable stainless steel processed by selective laser melting at low power.
summary_en.method: Experimental characterization of microstructures and mechanical properties of SLM-fabricated steel with varying process parameters.
summary_en.result: Low-power SLM yields high ductility due to the TRIP effect, enabling large uniform elongation.
summary_en.validation: Validation via tensile testing and microstructural analysis (EBSD, XRD).

papers.title: Tantalum-incorporated hydroxyapatite coating on titanium implants: its mechanical and in vitro osteogenic properties.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: The fabrication of bioactive coatings on metallic implants to enhance osseointegration has become a topic of general interest in orthopedics and dentistry. Hydroxyapatite (HA) coating has been shown to induce bone formation and promote bone-implant integration. Unfortunately, poor mechanical performance has hindered this from becoming a favorable coating material. The majority of present studies have focused in incorporating different elements into HA coatings to improve mechanical properties. In recent years, tantalum (Ta) has received increasing attention due to its excellent biocompatibility and corrosion resistance. The aim of on the present study was to investigate the fabrication and biological performance of Ta-incorporated HA coatings. METHODS: Ta-incorporated HA coatings were fabricated using the plasma spray technique on a titanium substrate, and the surface characteristics and mechanical properties were examined. In addition, the effects of Ta-incorporated HA coatings on the biological behavior of mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs) were investigated. RESULTS: Ta-incorporated HA coatings with microporous structure had higher roughness and wettability. In addition, the bonding strength of Ta/HA coatings with the substrate was substantially superior to HA coatings. Furthermore, Ta-incorporated HA coatings not only facilitated initial cell adhesion and faster proliferation, but also promoted the osteogenic differentiation of BMSCs. CONCLUSION: These results indicate that the incorporation of Ta could improve mechanical performance and increase the osteogenic activity of HA coatings. The Ta-incorporated HA coating fabricated by plasma spraying is expected to be a promising bio-coating material for metallic implants.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该研究涉及涂层制备和体外骨整合性能，但未使用增材制造技术，与用户方向间接相关。
llm.why_not_core: No additive manufacturing (LPBF) fabrication, no porous structure design, no fatigue testing, and no stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高羟基磷灰石涂层的力学性能和骨整合能力。
summary_zh.method: 采用等离子喷涂在钛基底上制备含钽的羟基磷灰石涂层。
summary_zh.result: 含钽涂层提升了粗糙度、润湿性和结合强度，并促进了骨髓间充质干细胞的粘附、增殖和成骨分化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和体外细胞实验验证涂层性能。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the mechanical properties and osseointegration of hydroxyapatite coatings on metallic implants.
summary_en.method: Tantalum-incorporated hydroxyapatite coatings were fabricated on titanium substrates using the plasma spray technique.
summary_en.result: The Ta-incorporated coatings exhibited higher roughness, wettability, and bonding strength, and enhanced initial cell adhesion, proliferation, and osteogenic differentiation of BMSCs.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (bonding strength) and in vitro cell studies with BMSCs.
